description: This file contains common IPC-related helper function declarations for encoding events, requests, and responses in a device service context. It includes function prototypes for populating device resources, endpoints, and device information structures from device-related types.

methods.name: populateDSResource
methods.description: Populates a DSResource structure from an icDeviceResource object.

methods.name: populateDSEndpoint
methods.description: Populates a DSEndpoint structure from an icDeviceEndpoint object.

methods.name: populateDSDevice
methods.description: Populates a DSDevice structure from an icDevice object.
